subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). UNIVERSAL: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE with no phrase; EC-OO-CONFORMANCE is not set (OK 7)). OoEmitter.EmitObjectView emits a plain reference conversion, and EcBinder binds no EC-OO-CONFORMANCE guard for a universal view. Golden: `SET OU2 TO OD AS UNIVERSAL`, `INVOKE OU AS UNIVERSAL "SPEAK"` (the dynamic path) and a view of a view. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
